codex: stark monochrome black and white only: bright white stretch spandex across the mask, chest, back and arms, glossy black rubberized panels down both sides of the torso and along the inner arms and legs, black gloves, black boots from the knee down, black shoulder yokes, narrow silver mirrored angular eye lenses outlined in black. The back is white with the black side panels continuing and a thin black seam down the spine. No other colours at all.

The back has a large red panel across the shoulders and upper back tapering down the spine into blue.
